task.title: P6-074: Fix board-blind needs arithmetic that contradicts board-aware rows
task.description:
Migrated from specs/TODO-Phase-6.md (Stage 4 — Correctness, Needs, shopping and pull). Original id: P6-074. Size: M. Specs: specs/collection-api.md, specs/app-ui.md.

**Board-blind needs arithmetic contradicts board-aware rows on the same page.** `hosted.rs:1372-1396` groups desires and holdings by `oracle_id` alone while the card rows and deck slot counts group by `(oracle_id, board)`, and `NeedRow` (`shared/collection.rs:615`) has no `board` field — so a deck holding a card on `main` and wanting it on `side` renders a Sideboard row reading HERE — / WANTED 1 while the needs chip is absent and `/needs` returns `rows: []`. `hosted.rs:919` already carries a comment naming this exact discrepancy. Fixing only the page's totals would make the chip disagree with the page it links to; the honest fix is `NeedRow.board` + a board-aware `needs()`.
